disclosed_components_from_supplied_paper.task: Lesion segmentation plus caption alignment/retrieval for lung CT slices.
disclosed_components_from_supplied_paper.backbone: CLIP ViT-L/14-336 is reported as the strongest SegCT-CLIP backbone.
disclosed_components_from_supplied_paper.visual_branch: Dual-level low/high transformer visual features are aggregated and passed to a lightweight visual decoder for lesion-mask prediction.
disclosed_components_from_supplied_paper.text_branch: A predefined clinically curated caption repository is encoded by the CLIP text encoder; captions are retrieved by cosine similarity to high-level image embeddings.
disclosed_components_from_supplied_paper.training_triplet: Input slice, retrieved/relevant caption, ground-truth lesion mask.
disclosed_components_from_supplied_paper.training_loss: Weighted contrastive plus Dice objective with lambda_contrastive=0.3 and lambda_dice=0.7.
disclosed_components_from_supplied_paper.evaluation_protocol: Bidirectional SegDB-1/SegDB-2 cross-dataset evaluation without target fine-tuning is described.
disclosed_components_from_supplied_paper.published_backbone_result_note: Published table values are literature values only and are not treated as rerun results.
